description: This file defines a utility function `shapeAgentGroupedSeries` that processes raw records related to costs grouped by agents and categories. It transforms the data into a format suitable for visualization with zero-filled categories for consistency across agents.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries
methods.description: Transforms raw cost records into a grouped dataset compatible with Recharts, ensuring all categories are represented for each agent with zero-filling where data is missing.
